and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimea the third,

people.name: Abinadab
people.line: Son of Jesse, brother of David

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. He said, “Yahweh has not chosen this one, either.”
translations.bsb: Then Jesse called Abinadab and presented him to Samuel, who said, “The LORD has not chosen this one either.”
translations.kjv: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. And he said, Neither hath the LORD chosen this.
translations.asv: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. And he said, Neither hath Jehovah chosen this.
